title: Seawalk Sanctuary | KEY.co
meta_description: Four Levels of Elevated Coastal Perfection
description_expanded: The home’s layout is designed to elevate daily living as naturally as it supports memorable entertaining. The first level opens to a relaxed lounge with direct access to the pool patio and private beach walkway, offering a seamless transition from indoor comfort to outdoor indulgence. Above, the second level is dedicated to rest and rejuvenation, featuring multiple king suites and a custom bunk retreat arranged around shared balconies and Gulf views, allowing families and friends to stay connected while enjoying privacy. The third level serves as the heart of the home, where a gourmet kitchen, dining areas, and living spaces flow together in a light-filled setting framed by panoramic views. Sliding glass doors extend the experience outdoors, creating an effortless connection between conversation, cuisine, and coastal air. It’s tricky to choose a new build when booking a vacation. Any property with little to no reviews tend to scare us away. We took a chance (since the photos were truly amazing) and we were blown away. Simply put, the home and location made us feel like we were celebrities. It was so luxurious. Everything was great…simple but fine furnishings, great fluffy pillows, soft linens and beach towels (lots of them!), stocked kitchen, washer/dryer on every floor, bikes, beach chairs…I can go on and on. Waking up to the ocean view was the icing on the cake. We cooked dinner here every night and had plenty of room to eat together in the giant main area. The house also had lots of extra space to spread out and have alone time too. Property management was very attentive and ready to help with anything we needed/wanted. Top notch!!

Features: No pets are allowed due to our homes being hypoallergenic.
